output.narrowClaim: Hugging Face says it is partnering with OpenRouter so Hub open-weight models a provider serves can be called with a Hugging Face token over the same API, with the best of 80+ providers picked per request; today it is switching Inference Providers’ language-model router from its own custom router to OpenRouter’s, with retries, while existing caller code stays the same.

quoteLocation.excerpt: Hugging Face and OpenRouter are teaming up to make open-weight models easy to run. Every major open-weight release is already being published on the Hugging Face Hub, and OpenRouter serves those models at scale, routing each request across 80+ providers based on live measurements of each one. Together, every open-weight model on the Hub that a provider serves can be called with your Hugging Face token, through the same API, with the best provider picked for each request. Today, we are switching Inference Providers from our own custom router to OpenRouter's. Requests made to language models now go through OpenRouter, which picks the best provider for each call based on live price, speed and reliability, and retries on another provider if the first one fails. Your code stays the same.
